symptom: `mxcli test --local` on PostgreSQL (the default) kept the `<app>_test` scratch database between runs, as the file database did before ako/mxcli#1853: a test asserting an empty table PASSed on run 1 and FAILed on run 2 after an `@cleanup none` test committed one row (11.12.2, PostgreSQL 15)
cause: `EnsureDatabase` creates the role and database only when missing and is otherwise a no-op, so a second run boots on whatever the first left. Nothing in the boot ever emptied it
file: `cmd/mxcli/docker/localapp.go` (`LocalAppOptions.FreshDB`, renamed from FreshFileDB, now also covers PostgreSQL via `emptyPostgresDatabase`); `cmd/mxcli/testrunner/localapp_options.go` sets it for every --local run
insight: Empty in place rather than drop and recreate: `DROP OWNED BY CURRENT_USER`, as the app role, connected to the scratch database, removes only objects in that database, so the dev loop's database owned by the same role cannot be reached, and nothing depends on CREATEDB or a superuser at the moment the data is already gone. Public survives (owned by pg_database_owner from PG15; by postgres before) and the role can still create in it. Measured before choosing: 88 relations to 0 on a database the runtime had booted on. Runtime control: main run 2 FAIL, fix both runs PASS, and the dev database `tapp` kept its 87 tables across both runs
